purpose: Reanalyse saved ideal probabilities for shot budgets, attribution and recoverable-but-difficult strata. No new final validation or adaptive solver selection.
limits: All64 are repeatedly inspected development examples; no new generalization evidence.
Shot counts use exact ideal probabilities and mean cohort optimum success, not observed success or a per-instance guarantee.
Logical RZZ count times shots is only an entangling-operation volume, not runtime or billing; all64 are charged shots, including Babai successes unknown to the solver.
Conditional strata are evaluation labels only; no oracle case filtering is a deployable method.
Classical CBD and local-search candidates have different generation costs; sample counts are not end-to-end time comparisons.
